With the current published installer payloads, Aurora is not expected to start yet. A manually assembled boot chain has started Aurora only with changes that are still under review; with those changes, HDMI, the front USB ports and Ethernet worked. Even with those changes, the rear USB-C ports and GPU acceleration did not work. Installs go ahead only after the owner acknowledges the warning and the recovery steps.
